import collections, gzip, hashlib, json, pathlib, random, subprocess, sys
from fractions import Fraction
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.extend(('src','results/T-044/tests','D:/RCA-ext/envs/py312-pin/Lib/site-packages','D:/RCA-ext/envs/T-016-cong-cu/Lib/site-packages'))
from m1 import chuoi, doi_chung, hop_dong
from sinh_trace_S import params
def original(path):
 ns={}
 exec(compile(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+path]),path,'exec'),ns)
 return ns
old=original('src/m1/doi_chung.py')['cd3']
old_chain=original('src/m1/chuoi.py')['chay']
rng=random.Random(5203)
statuses=collections.Counter()
for i in range(5000):
 n=list('abcdefg')[:rng.randrange(1,8)]
 g=[(a,b) for a in n for b in n if (i%2 or a<b) and rng.randrange(5)==0]
 d={v:Fraction(rng.randrange(-4,9),rng.choice((1,2,3,5))) for v in n if rng.randrange(4)}
 t=[v for v in n+['outside'] if rng.randrange(3)==0]
 left,right=old(g,d,t),doi_chung.cd3(g,d,t)
 assert left==right,(i,left,right)
 statuses[right['trang_thai']]+=1
print('SYNTHETIC_EQUIVALENCE',dict(statuses),flush=True)
for n, label in (((), 'invalid_intermediates'), (('c','d'),'long_flagged_dag')):
 groups=[['c']]+[[f'x{i}_{j}' for j in range(2)] for i in range(30)]+[['d']]
 edges=[(b,a) for left,right in zip(groups,groups[1:]) for a in left for b in right]
 d={v:1 for g in groups for v in g} if n else {'c':1,'d':1}
 r=doi_chung.cd3(edges,d,['d'])
 assert r['diem_ung_vien']==({'c':32.0} if n else {})
 print('LAYERED_DAG',label,r['trang_thai'],r['diem_ung_vien'],flush=True)
spans=[dict(traceID=str(i),spanID='s',parentSpanID='',owner='svc',operation='op',
            start_us=(950+i*2 if i<20 else 1010+(i-20)*2)*10**6,
            duration_us=1000 if i<20 else 2000) for i in range(40)]
for name,change in (('M1',{'E1':'U','E2':'C','E5':True}),('C-a0',{}),('C-a1',{'E1':'U'})):
 p=params(change)
 p.update(config_id=name,nhanh_z=True,che_do={'cong_phan_vi':'G3','cong_dem':'D1','thang':'E4+T4c'})
 if name!='M1':p['doi_chung']=name
 args=(spans,[],[],['svc'],{},1000)
 legacy=chuoi.chay(*args,p)
 assert legacy==old_chain(*args,p)
 split=hop_dong.kiem_ban_ghi(chuoi.chay(*args,dict(p,tach_cd3=True)))
 assert split['status']=='OK'
 with patch.object(doi_chung,'cd3',side_effect=RuntimeError('only C-d3')) as f:
  assert chuoi.chay(*args,dict(p,tach_cd3=True))==split
  f.assert_not_called()
  assert chuoi.chay(*args,p)['status']=='ERROR'
 broken=chuoi.chay(*args,dict(p,tach_cd3=1))
 assert broken['status']=='ERROR' and 'tach_cd3' in broken['error']
 split=json.loads(json.dumps(split,allow_nan=False))
 payload=split['extra'].pop('dau_vao_cd3')
 score={e:Fraction(*q) for e,q in payload.pop('diem').items()}
 split['extra']['doi_chung']['C-d3']=dict(doi_chung.cd3(split['extra']['canh'],score,payload['dich']),**payload)
 assert split==json.loads(json.dumps(legacy))
 print('ISOLATION_AND_ROUNDTRIP',name,flush=True)
def rd(path): return json.loads(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes())
def check(path,index):
 b=pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()
 assert len(b)==index[path]['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==index[path]['sha256'],path
 return b
m=rd('results/T-053/manifest.json')['outputs']
p='results/T-053/runs/k-dong-pha1-001/seal.json'
seal=json.loads(check(p,m))
count=collections.Counter()
for window,entries in seal.items():
 for entry in entries:
  p=entry['path']
  assert entry['sha256']==m[p]['sha256']
  for rec in map(json.loads,gzip.decompress(check(p,m)).splitlines()):
   if rec['config_id'] not in ('K-E1+E2+E5','K-R0','K-E1'): continue
   ex=rec['extra']
   sc={r['thuc_the']:max(q['s'] for q in ex['kenh_co'] if q['thuc_the']==r['thuc_the']) for r in ex['kenh_co']}
   ref=ex['doi_chung']['C-d3']
   g,t=ex['canh'],ref['dich']
   left,right=old(g,sc,t),doi_chung.cd3(g,sc,t)
   assert left==right,(p,rec['config_id'])
   assert ref['trang_thai']==right['trang_thai']
   assert [b['groups'] for b in ref['blocks']]==[b['groups'] for b in right['blocks']]
   count[(window,rec['config_id'])]+=1
print('PINNED_DEV_REPLAY',dict(count),flush=True)
